description.en: Used cos²θ instead of sin²θ, putting the maximum along the dipole axis instead of perpendicular to it.
description.et: Kasutas cos²θ, mitte sin²θ, paigutades maksimumi dipooli teljele, mitte sellega risti.

description.en: Used sinθ instead of sin²θ, forgetting the pattern is proportional to the square of the sine.
description.et: Kasutas sinθ, mitte sin²θ, unustades, et muster on võrdeline siinuse ruuduga.

description.en: Passed the angle in degrees straight into sine without converting to radians first.
description.et: Andis nurga kraadides otse siinusesse, teisendamata seda kõigepealt radiaanidesse.
